limitations: The convergence theorem is conditional on forward boundedness and does not establish global boundedness. Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The full text of Demina and Ilyukhin (2023), DOI 10.1134/S0037446623050075, was not inspected; its accessible abstract concerns invariant algebraic manifolds of the same system and is the principal identified residual prior-coverage risk. An equivalent identity under another normalization could also remain unlocated. The theorem concerns the autonomous reduced ODE, not higher-order corrected magnetoconvection models or the parent PDE.
provenance: A theorem for the Rucklidge ordinary differential equation derived from an exact polynomial balance identity and compared with global-dynamics, integrability, invariant-manifold and periodic-orbit literature.
record_title: An exact balance law and a damping-sign recurrence barrier for the Rucklidge flow
